title: Conditional Umegaki and complete equal-reference SLD order share a constant
statement: For finite-dimensional quantum channels P,Q, one uniform conditional Umegaki relative-entropy order is equivalent to the complete equal-reference SLD metric order with the same constant, for arbitrary finite references.

requires: Two finite-dimensional channels with the same input.
Arbitrary finite reference, faithful baseline and zero-reference Hermitian tangent.
provides: Transfers a uniform conditional Umegaki comparison to complete equal-reference SLD order and back with unchanged c.
assumptions: Output states restricted to effective support; common faithful regularization for finite boundary pairs.
costs: A proof-level order interface; no acquisition, device, or computational efficiency is implied.
contract.units: Dimensionless entropy contraction / SLD metric coefficient.
contract.obstruction: Does not equate the result to complete equal-reference Umegaki for arbitrary quantum channels.

evidence.range_scope: Universal conditional order / complete equal-reference SLD interface
evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; source-reported unless a version-bound review overlay states otherwise.

body: N966 uses the saturated-reference filter only in the necessity direction; the return implication uses the SLD reference-score gauge, SLD-to-BKM integral and state-pair interpolation.

review.scope: Exact finite-dimensional interface stated in N966; no arbitrary-channel complete-Umegaki equality.
